title: Lena and the Extraction
author: Ulyana Underhill
blurb: Odile Montrose, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
